General information.Name: market for water pump, 22kW
General information.Category: Manufactura/2812 Manufacture of fluid power equipment
General information.Description: This is a market activity representing the consumption mix of a water pump product in the Global geography. The market connects suppliers with consumers of the same product in the same geographical area, grouping producers and imports while accounting for transport to consumers and relevant losses. This represents a mobile infrastructure for a water pump used for agricultural irrigation (both surface water and groundwater) with total mass of 300 kg, engine nominal power of 22 KW, volumetric capacity of 30 m3/h for delivery pressure of 7 to 8 bar. Lifetime is 10 years with lifetime capacity of 317,442.01 m3. The process includes input materials, infrastructure use, treatment and end-of-life of the pump but excludes energy consumption to assemble the pump. The activity starts at the gate of activities producing 'water pump, 22KW' in Global geography and ends with supply to consumers including transport.
